s1.quote: The deepest sections reach 100 metres (330 ft).

s2.quote: The deepest sections reach 98 metres (320 ft) … Each diver must be guided to minimise the risk of taking a wrong turn … dive-slots must be reserved, often months in advance

s3.quote: the water is warm (20-28 Celsius degrees) all year round

access.value: Guided dives only; slots booked months ahead

summary.text: A flooded thermal-spring cave beneath Budapest, fed by warm water and reaching about 100 m in its deepest sections. Dives are guided and must be booked well ahead.
